title: Bound retained count backing during native extent preparation
body:
## Summary

The native caller's occupied count-content bound excludes retained backing. This adds one source-bound preparation component, including erased cells, LEFT and index padding:

```text
Layout.extents private count backing <= S + max(I+2,3W+9)
returned marginal backing = sum(bit_length(e_i)+3)
Count.product exact peak = A+B+C+6+max(0,A+2-v_2(b))
```

Start with `research/selected-extent-count-backing/README.md` and `PROOF.md` for the exact domain and symbol definitions. A successful zero-exponent fixture needs 21 cells with an 8-bit index and 267 with a 256-bit index; both return the same 12-cell marginal cohort. Final count values alone therefore miss a real transient.

This closes the Natural extent-preparation part of the [released PR2905 handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18968830). PR2749's occupied-content theorem and PR2905's internal ADD countdown backing remain predecessor results. Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's PR2697 implementation, Ross Richardson's exports and numerical analysis, kumagi/PR2882, PR2902 and the retained lineage. Source bytes and notices are pinned and unchanged. Substantial AI assistance was used, including a separate internal derivation/review; no independent human review is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the three-root product budget is 9 for inputs (1,1), but literal source reaches 12. A width-independent extent budget misses the successful 267-cell padding fixture.
- **After:** a written all-parameter lifetime proof, 4,099 exact product replays, 58 extent preparations, six complete native ADD address-permutation checks and four embedded controls pass. Seven tests cover underbudgets, erased backing, source corruption and hostile/None module bindings.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay and optimized CPython 3.14.8 replay/tests pass on macOS arm64. Lint passes. The internal review caught a module-restoration defect; its fix and regression pass, with no remaining review objections.
- Source baseline is canonical main `0706e744c`; submission refresh `475fec190` has identical guidance, selected record and consumed runtime bytes. Final complete metadata scan covers 491 open PRs, 2,115 closed/merged PRs and 1,585 Discussion records, with no warnings. Metadata coverage excludes arbitrary diffs and unpublished work.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/selected-extent-count-backing
```

[Canonical claim and result](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18969985). Remaining obligations are simultaneous callback/program/record backing, total private A, physical placement/reuse and selected supplier admission. No new kappa, full selected GL64 execution, failure-cleanup proof or full frontier cold replay is claimed. Hosted CI is separate.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

One opt-in research package. Existing suppliers and selected frontier are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** research
